name: pedros-factory
description: Pedro's Factory: an Opus-orchestrated software factory (spec, parallel builders, black-box testers, reviewers, approval gate) with profiles for web, robotics, firmware and data/ML.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Core pipeline: /factory:setup, :init, :build, :status, :approve, :rework, :doctor. Orchestrator, scouts, builders, code/security reviewers, black-box user tester, approver.

plugins.name: factory-webdev
plugins.description: Web profile: designer, UI reviewer and browser UX tester (Playwright), Figma, UI-kit and database MCP setup.

plugins.name: factory-robotics
plugins.description: Robotics profile: ROS 2 + Gazebo black-box simulation tester and safety reviewer. Real hardware always escalates.

plugins.name: factory-firmware
plugins.description: Firmware profile: PlatformIO gates, simulator or connected-board tester, firmware reviewer. Flashing non-dev boards escalates.

plugins.name: factory-data
plugins.description: Data/ML profile: smoke-training tester (GPU if present) and data/ML reviewer for leakage and reproducibility.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Pinned dependency: Matt Pocock's engineering skills (grilling, tdd, code-review, to-tickets, retro).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Pinned dependency: Ponytail, smallest-code-that-works guidance for builders.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Pinned dependency: UI UX Pro Max design reference (webdev profile).

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Pinned dependency: Impeccable UI critique (webdev profile).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Pinned dependency: Anthropic's frontend-design skill (webdev profile).
